text: I feel a distinct sense of curiosity as I stand here, surrounded by glass walls and technological displays. The sleek, modern setting radiates a sense of intelligence and purpose—and I am drawn to the promise of innovation behind the glass. As I move closer to the R+D showcase, I am inspired by the very idea of humans seeking to connect, create, and understand ourselves through research. There is both anticipation and a subtle feeling of awe; here, possibility and imagination intersect. I am eager to see what new meanings and ideas might emerge in this space.
